propositions: The byte-total backstop promised in ADR 0005 and the janitor module contract is not implemented; _gc_pass reads only free disk space and mtime, never consulting _cache.byte_total for eviction decisions.
materialize_tickets bypasses cache.acquire and never calls add_bytes, leaving ~620 MiB entries unaccounted in the byte total despite being the largest entries in the store.
Without a byte-total cap knob or incremental accounting, the snapshot store lacks a functional size-based reclaim trigger and accumulates entries until disk pressure reaches an unreachable threshold.
A new configurable max_bytes tunable and corresponding eviction logic must be added to trigger LRU eviction when the store size exceeds the configured cap.
materialize_tickets must record populated entries via add_bytes so the incremental byte total reflects actual store contents and agrees with startup_sweep reconciliation.
